title: Dark nights, strong habits
headline: Dark Nights, Strong Habits
detail: Your week at POWR starts here
caption:
The evenings are drawing in, but the studio lights are on 🕯️

This is the time of year motivation dips. A routine you've booked in ahead makes it so much easier to keep showing up for yourself.

Whether it's Reformer, Mat or a gentle Stretch, there's a class at POWR for every body and every level. Beginners are always welcome.

If you've been looking for Pilates in Clitheroe to see you through the darker months, now's the perfect time to start.

The November timetable is coming soon. Book your spot for this week through the link in our bio.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
